title: Sonolith API: registration, sessions and events

ScopeRequest.description: A scope the app asks for, with the reason shown to the user.

required.description: True: the app cannot work without it and the user cannot untick it. False: the user can untick it.

reason.description: Why the app needs it, in one short sentence the user reads, for example `To show the current song in your bar`. 1–120 characters.

Icon.description: A square PNG icon as a data URI (`data:image/png;base64,…`), at least 64×64 px (256×256 recommended), at most 65536 characters. Remote URLs are not accepted.

RegistrationPending.description: The request is waiting for the user. Its outcome arrives as `registration.resolved` with the same `requestId`.

identity.description: The app identity Sonolith derived for the calling process (SPEC section 6.6).

RequestScopesResult.description: `granted` when the app already has every requested scope (nothing is shown to the user), otherwise `pending`.

grantedScopes.description: The scopes the app has now.

kind.description: `register` (from `app.register`), `scopes` (from `app.requestScopes`) or `identity` (from `session.hello` after the app's executable changed).

status.description: `approved`, `denied` (the user said no), `blocked` (the user said no and blocked the app) or `expired` (nobody answered in time).

token.description: The new client token when `kind` is `register` and `status` is `approved`, otherwise null. Sent only this once.

grantedScopes.description: The app's scopes after an approval, otherwise null.

retryAfterMs.description: When `status` is `denied` or `expired`: how long until the app may ask again. Otherwise null.

AppIdentity.description: Who the calling process is, as Sonolith derives it from the operating system (SPEC section 6.6). A token is bound to `key`.

kind.description: `executable` (a native program), `interpreter` (a script run by an interpreter), `appimage` or `flatpak`.

key.description: The normalized identity Sonolith compares, for example `interp:python3:/home/alex/bin/bar.py`. Version segments are replaced by `*`; lower case on Windows.

executable.description: The verified executable path as the operating system reports it.

interpreter.description: The interpreter family, for example `python3` or `node`, when `kind` is `interpreter`; otherwise null.

script.description: The absolute script path from the command line, or `module:<name>` for `python -m`, when `kind` is `interpreter` and there is one; otherwise null. Taken from the command line, not verified.

appImage.description: The AppImage file's path when `kind` is `appimage`; otherwise null.

flatpakId.description: The Flatpak app id when `kind` is `flatpak`; otherwise null.

Token.description: A client token: `snl_` followed by 43 base64url characters (256 random bits). A secret: store it like a password.

appVersion.description: Sonolith's own version. Informational; check `apiVersion` for compatibility.

signedIn.description: Whether the user is signed in to a YouTube account in Sonolith.

identity.description: The app identity Sonolith derived for the calling process (SPEC section 6.6).
The app identity Sonolith derived for the calling process (SPEC section 6.6).

topics.description: Every event topic this Sonolith supports.

session.description: The calling app's session, or null before `session.hello`.

Topic.description: An event topic to subscribe to.

SubscribeResult.description: The connection's subscriptions after the call.

positionHz.description: How many `player.position` events per second this connection gets while playing.

reason.description: `removed` (the user removed the app in Sonolith), `blocked` (the user blocked it), `unregistered` (the app unregistered itself on another connection) or `replaced` (the app registered again and got a new token). Treat unknown values as `removed`.
